name: The Rockstar is my Boyfriend
source: Arisa Roy is hired as a manager to produce a rock band that will shake the world.  After the selection, the team works together to record a demo song, their first concert, and even compete for Arisa's affection. Meanwhile, a camera crew films the whole process to compile into a reality show.
translation: 有纱·罗伊受聘担任乐队经纪人，负责打造一支足以震撼全世界的摇滚乐队。选拔结束后，乐队成员们齐心协力录制试听小样、筹备首场演唱会，甚至为了赢得有纱的芳心而展开激烈竞争。与此同时，一支摄影团队正全程跟拍记录这一切，准备将其剪辑成一档真人秀节目。
